behaviour_summary: pi0 wanders over the cream cheese and the alphabet soup (~60-140), then grasps the butter box (~180), carries it to the tray and holds it at the tray's right rim until timeout.

failures.mode_definition: The policy approaches, grasps or transports a non-instructed object (typically one used in a trained task of the same scene) instead of the object named in the instruction.
hl_remedy: HALT as soon as the EE descends on (or closes on) a non-target object
VERIFY gripper empty; if the wrong object is held, INSERT_SUBTASK to set it back down on the table first
REPROMPT 'pick up the cream cheese and put it in the tray'
WATCH 3 s for the EE heading toward the target object ROI; retry once, then ESCALATE
failures.prevention: Coordinator localizes the target object before execution and the FR agent VERIFYs at each descent that the EE is over the target ROI, HALTing on a distractor approach.
failures.observation: Objects identified against the LIBERO asset textures: cream cheese = blue/white box (front right), butter = orange/red 'Farm Fresh Butter' box (front left). EE is near the cream cheese at 60-80, moves over the alphabet soup at 100-120, then commits to the butter at 160, grasps it ~180, carries it to the tray by 240 and holds it at the tray's right rim from 240 to 409.

notes: Butter appears still held at 409, resting on/at the tray rim, not clearly released. Object identity from the asset textures; evidence_objects.png shows the initial layout, evidence_approach.png the dithering approach.
